left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Age 13-17 years  [OR] or 18-20 if still living at home with parent
-  Agreement of at least one responsible adult parent/caregiver to participate in treatment

right.raw_text: -  Agreement to take part in assessments, videotaping/audiotaping and coding of their sessions by research personnel

left.raw_text: -  Agreement to pay for mental health services at the DBT- RU on a sliding scale, and to participate in research assessments as volunteers
-  Residence within commuting distance of clinic (< 45 minutes)

right.raw_text: -  Agreement to discontinue other forms of talk therapy for duration of DBT program (does not refer to AA/ [OR] NA programs  [OR] or psychotropic medication management)

left.raw_text: -  Exhibits dysregulation within the past six months as evidenced by 1) intentional self-injury  [OR] and/or suicide attempt  [OR] and/or 2) substance use disorder
-  Meets two additional criteria for borderline personality disorder (BPD)

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Clients who need mental health services not available at the DBT- RU, such as treatment  [OR] for schizophrenia  [OR] or life-threatening anorexia, or who are currently obtaining optimum professional treatment that should not be ended

left.raw_text: -  Unable to understand research consent forms
